---
title: "Schedule"
---

A 3-hour in-person workshop (180 minutes), including one break. It runs in the Wednesday 11 November morning tutorial block at LatinR 2026 (8:30 to 12:00), which leaves a little slack at the end for questions and overruns.

Each module ends with an exercise. Because we are in the same room, those are done at your laptop with the instructor and your neighbours close by, so ask for help or compare screens as you go.

| Time | Duration | Module | Topic | Slides |
|------|---------:|--------|-------|--------|
| 0:00 | 10 min | — | Welcome and setup check | — |
| 0:10 | 30 min | [01](materials/01-quarto.qmd) | What is Quarto? The anatomy of a reveal.js deck | [deck](slides/01-quarto.qmd) |
| 0:40 | 40 min | [02](materials/02-theming.qmd) | Theming: colors, fonts, sizes, SCSS | [deck](slides/02-theming.qmd) |
| 1:20 | 10 min | — | Break | — |
| 1:30 | 40 min | [03](materials/03-content.qmd) | Content: elements & layout | [deck](slides/03-content.qmd) |
| 2:10 | 30 min | [04](materials/04-interactivity.qmd) | Interactivity: fragments & auto-animate | [deck](slides/04-interactivity.qmd) |
| 2:40 | 20 min | [05](materials/05-extensions.qmd) | Extensions & wrap-up | [deck](slides/05-extensions.qmd) |
